name: Neon
description: Managed Postgres, 0.5 GB of storage per project, 100 projects, 10 branches per project, 100 CU-hours of compute per project per month, autoscaling up to 2 CU, scales to zero after 5 minutes. Includes S3-compatible Object Storage with 5 GB per project that branches with the database. 5 GB of network transfer per project, shared across all products.
